test_title: PYST 60: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Two trains of lengths 310 m and 340 m, respectively, are 285 m apart. They start moving towards each other on parallel tracks, at the speeds of 151 km/h and 155 km/h, respectively. In how much time will the trains cross each other completely?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of Train 1 = 310 m

Length of Train 2 = 340 m

Distance between trains = 285 m

Speed of Train 1 = 151 km/h

Speed of Train 2 = 155 km/h

**Formula used:**

Relative Speed = Speed of Train 1 + Speed of Train 2 (when moving towards each other)

Time taken = Total distance / Relative speed

Total distance = Distance between trains + Length of Train 1 + Length of Train 2

**Calculations:**

Total distance = 285 + 310 + 340 = 935 m = 0.935 km

Speed of Train 1 = 151 km/h = (151 times 1000)/(3600) = 41.94 m/s

Speed of Train 2 = 155 km/h = (155 times 1000)/(3600) = 43.05 m/s

Relative speed = 151 + 155 = 306 km/h

Time taken = (0.935)/(306) hours = (0.935 times 3600)/(306) s

⇒ Time taken = 11 s

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
